properties.notes: The South East Lincolnshire Strategic Housing Land Availability Assessment (SHLAA) (April 2017) identifies that Mill Drove has poor visibility at its junction with Stonegate which is a problem that will need to be overcome to the satisfaction of the Highway Authority. SHLAA ref no: Cow008. Pending application is an outline application for up to 45 dwellings and includes adjacent land (greenfield) not included on register.
